general.q: What is PASIFLOW and what does it do?
general.a: PASIFLOW is an end-to-end technology and investment platform that organizes high-yield, professionally managed, and 100% government-backed (Section 8) real estate investments in the US real estate market.

general.q: How is it different from other turnkey companies?
general.a: We don't just sell; we also personally handle the management of the property we acquire. With our own field teams, your dedicated account manager, and our transparent panel technology, we adopt a 'long-term partnership' model, not a 'sell and forget' one.

Our founding team has 20+ years of experience and over $250M in real estate transaction volume in the US. Also, we use the Section 8 investment model we offer to evaluate our own family savings. We invest in exactly what we offer you.
It is ideal for busy professionals, investors seeking passive income, and anyone who wants to earn dollars without dealing with property management (tenants, renovations, etc.).

process.q: Do I need to come to America?
process.a: No. The entire process (selection, purchase, title transfer, management) is conducted 100% remotely and digitally. Of course, you can visit your properties in person if you wish.

process.q: How will I track my investment?
process.a: Through your private Pasiflow Investor Panel, you can track rent payments, maintenance reports, financial statements, and title deeds instantly 24/7. Also, your dedicated Account Manager is there for every question.

process.q: How long does the process take?
process.a: After property selection, purchase and title transfer (closing) takes an average of 14-21 days for cash purchases. For financed purchases, this period can take 45-60 days.

property.a: We currently focus on regions offering the highest rental yield (ROI) and appreciation potential: Detroit (MI), Cleveland (OH), Memphis (TN), and St. Louis (MO). These regions are markets where the Section 8 system works most efficiently.
Absolutely. Every property goes through a 3-stage check by our field teams, licensed 'inspectors', and municipal inspections. We only add properties to the portfolio that meet our standards.

property.q: How do maintenance and repair processes work?
property.a: We have our own full-time maintenance teams. Instead of calling expensive outside services for small repairs, we produce solutions quickly and at costs well below market rates with our own teams. All transactions are reported with photos in your panel.

property.q: What happens if the tenant leaves?
property.a: Section 8 tenants typically stay for very long periods (average 5-7 years). If they leave, the PASIFLOW marketing team immediately finds new tenant candidates, passes them through security clearance, and places them.

financial.q: What is the minimum investment amount?
financial.a: We have portfolios starting from the $85,000 - $120,000 range for cash purchases. For those using financing (Mortgage), a minimum 30-35% down payment (approx. $30k-$40k) is sufficient.

financial.q: What is the expected Return on Investment (ROI)?
financial.a: Depending on our regions, annual NET Dollar-Based Return (ROI) is between 10% - 14% after all expenses are deducted. Additionally, 5-8% annual real estate appreciation is projected.

A large portion of your rent (between 70%-100%) is backed by the US Government (Section 8 program) and is deposited automatically on the 1st of every month. Even if the tenant doesn't pay, the government share enters our account.
We are very transparent: We charge a one-time consulting/closing fee of $3,500 per property and a management fee (property management fee) of 10% of monthly rental income. No hidden costs.
Rent is collected between the 1st and 5th of every month, expenses are deducted, and it is directly transferred to your bank account in Turkey or the US in Dollars on the 15th.

legal.q: Is the property in my name?
legal.a: Yes. The title deed (Deed) is made directly in your name or the name of the LLC company we will establish. Property rights in the US are very strong and completely under your control.

legal.q: Is it mandatory to form a company (LLC)?
legal.a: It is not mandatory but we strongly recommend it. An LLC protects you from legal risks (Limited Liability) and provides significant tax advantages. We handle the establishment on your behalf as PASIFLOW (at a cost of $750).

Yes, but don't worry. There is a 'Double Taxation Prevention Treaty'. You can deduct the tax paid in the US in your home country. Also, with expenses like depreciation, there are opportunities to show lower profit on paper and legally pay $0 tax. We handle your annual tax filing for $99 with our partners.

legal.q: Do I need to be a US citizen?
legal.a: No. Having a passport is sufficient. You don't even need to go to the US or have a visa.

aboutSection.title: Welcome to the future of passive income investment in the USA.
aboutSection.opening: We founded Pasiflow with a single idea: To make rental income-based real estate investment in the USA understandable, transparent, and manageable for overseas investors.
aboutSection.p1: Real estate is one of the most powerful tools for building wealth when structured correctly. But when it comes to practice, especially in a remotely managed market like the USA, the process consists of many parts: right property selection, tenant placement, maintenance-repair, regulation, insurance, taxation, and professional management.
aboutSection.p2: In reality, investment is not just "buying a house"; it requires a well-structured operation from start to finish.
aboutSection.p3: Pasiflow steps in exactly at this point.
aboutSection.p4: Our goal is to gather the points where foreign investors struggle the most under a single structured system. We perform cash flow and rent potential-focused opportunity analysis and property selection, manage the compliance process for public-backed rent programs like Section 8, and conduct eligibility checks. While offering professional property management covering tenant communication, detailed reporting, and maintenance tracking, we ensure investors can monitor every detail in their portfolio transparently through a single dashboard thanks to our technological infrastructure.
aboutSection.questionIntro: In the beginning, we asked ourselves this question:
aboutSection.question: "How can an overseas investor manage this process without worrying about 'What happens now?' after buying a house in America?"
aboutSection.focus: Therefore, we focused on measureable cash flow, standard processes, regular reporting, and transparent communication.
aboutSection.method: We structured Pasiflow not as an intermediary firm explaining from a distance, but as a team that knows the field and truly manages the process. With +100M active broker experience in Florida and field experience in the US market, we build our model on a system that actually works in the field, not just "looks good on paper".
aboutSection.quote1: "What I am most proud of at Pasiflow today is that every number our investors see on the dashboard is the result of a real system working in the field."
aboutSection.vision: Our goal at Pasiflow today is clear: To provide a system where overseas investors can build a rental income-focused property portfolio in the USA, step by step, with controllable risks.

whyUsa.title: Why Invest in USA?
whyUsa.subtitle: Dollar-based passive income, strong property rights, and a transparent system.
whyUsa.intro: Our goal with PASIFLOW is simple: Minimize risk with the right properties in the right cities in the USA and create long-term regular cash flow.
whyUsa.section1Desc: America is a market where investor rights are strongly protected. Property rights and contracts are clear, market data is transparent, and long-term appreciation potential is high.
whyUsa.section2Desc: While income in local currencies often erodes against the dollar, rental income in the USA comes in dollars. Your purchasing power stays stable, and portfolio growth becomes more predictable.
whyUsa.section3Desc: In the USA, transactions typically go through a Title Company. This structure protects both parties by controlling title, money, and documentation. Records are auditable and processes are standard.
whyUsa.section4Desc: Government-backed rental programs provide significant advantages in PASIFLOW's focused models: A portion of rent is paid through the program, collection risk decreases, and cash flow becomes more plannable.
whyUsa.section5Desc: Owning assets in dollars makes your investment more resilient against fluctuations in local currencies.
whyUsa.ctaDesc: Real estate investments in America can have different tax advantages. Review our detailed guide to plan the most suitable structure together.

taxation.title: Taxation & Legal Structure
taxation.subtitle: Real Estate Investment in America
taxation.intro: Real estate investment is not just about earning rental income; you can also create higher net returns and sustainable financial structure through tax planning.
taxation.section1Desc: There is a Double Taxation Treaty between Turkey and the USA. You can deduct the rental income you earn in the USA when declaring in Turkey, avoiding double taxation on the same income.
taxation.section2Desc: PASIFLOW sets up LLC companies for investors. It provides Pass-Through taxation — you don't pay separate tax at the company level. It protects you from legal risks and separates your personal assets.
taxation.section3Desc: Besides being a property owner in the USA, you can deduct various expenses from your tax base: Property tax and insurance, management and maintenance costs, travel expenses, mortgage interest, and depreciation.
taxation.section4Desc: Depreciation is a particularly important advantage: You can reduce your tax base by deducting the structural portion of the property over the years. This reduces your annual tax burden to almost zero.
taxation.section5Desc: As PASIFLOW, we provide full support to our investors including annual tax reporting, preparation of official declarations, legal file tracking, and guidance from tax experts.
taxation.lifecycle1: Your property generates rent throughout the year
taxation.lifecycle3: Calculates depreciation and other deductible items
taxation.lifecycle4: Prepares and submits your declaration during tax season
taxation.lifecycle5: Provides reports for deduction in Turkey when needed
taxation.ctaDesc: The tax system in America may seem complex at first. However, with a transparent process, professional support, and proper planning, you can get maximum benefit from your investment.
